title: Sex-Specific Modeling
audience: Learners exploring sex-specific modeling and fairness in biomedical datasets.
objectives: Prepare an eICU-style dataset for sex-specific model analysis.
Compare variable patterns by sex and mortality status.
Calculate univariate odds ratios for female, male, and full-cohort groups.
Train multivariate models and compare AUROC across sex-specific cohorts.

sections.name: Data Processing
sections.purpose: Clean identifiers, encode categories, impute missing values, and create a model-ready dataset.

sections.name: Exploratory Analysis
sections.purpose: Filter patient data and inspect how selected variables differ by sex and mortality status.

sections.name: Univariate Analysis
sections.purpose: Estimate one-variable odds ratios separately for female, male, and full-cohort data.

sections.name: Multivariate Analysis
sections.purpose: Train logistic models and compare model discrimination using AUROC.

chatbot_guidance: Guide the learner through the analysis-step selector from data processing to multivariate analysis.
Explain sex-specific modeling in practical terms: the same feature can carry different predictive signal across groups.
Help interpret odds ratios, AUROC, and cohort differences without overclaiming causality.
Mention that this app uses the bundled demo dataset when available, with the remote source kept only as fallback.
